situation: Two sisters who both follow the same true crime podcast.
topic: Talking through the gruesome forensic details of an invented serial killer case, the injuries to the victims, the killer's psychology, and whether they find it disturbing or fascinating.

text: Did you listen to this week's episode yet
Yeah! Literally an hour ago 😬
The case with the marks on the victims
Oh god yeah that was intense. Genuinely uncomfortable to listen to on my commute home
I need to admit something kind of weird
Ok im listening lol
I found it fascinating. Like, not disturbed. Fascinated. The way the killer was systematic about it, the pattern of the injuries. I couldn't stop thinking about it during my shift
Thats not weird babe, thats literally why we listen to it 🤷‍♀️
Yeah but I mean I'm usually the one going "ok that's enough true crime for today" and you're the one wanting more details. This time I was the one wanting more
So what, you've switched?
I had a rough day on the ward. Maybe that's it. Someone deteriorated fast and we couldn't stabilise them and I just needed something that makes sense. Even if it's gruesome
Oh hun that's rough im sorry
It's fine. Not the first time. But yeah I think that's why the podcast hit differently. Everything in that case had logic to it. Cause and effect
That's actually pretty understandable. Our brains want patterns
Anyway. I'm not losing it
Never thought you were 😊
How's your Saturday going
Decent, got a brief due Monday so im being productive today you?
Just got back from the shops. Quiet morning shift yesterday so I slept in which was good
Nice. I'm gonna take a break in a bit, need coffee
I'm watching a show but it's not very good. Might delete it halfway through
Which one
That detective thing everyone was talking about last year. It's fine just not gripping
Fair enough, life's too short for boring shows
So my boss just emailed. The campaign we pitched three weeks ago? We got it
That's great! The one you weren't sure about?
Yeah that one. Honestly didn't think they'd go for it but they loved the angle
You should celebrate. Are you doing anything tonight
Might grab dinner with some work people but nothing locked in. Might just be a night in honestly, bit tired
You should go out. You've earned it
Ended up at Aria with two people from the team, it was good 😊 back home now
Good. How was it
Nice food, good conversation. One of them won't stop talking about moving to Melbourne which is apparently the new thing
Everyone's leaving Sydney
I know right, like it's not that bad here
You still up
Yeah, just on my phone in bed though
Same lol
New episode drops tomorrow yeah?
Monday I think actually
Oh right, Monday
Im gonna sleep, long week ahead
Yep good idea
